crossRefs.note: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent…
and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him…

translations.web: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
translations.bsb: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
translations.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried
translations.asv: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.
